# MERIDIAN

> Fictional settlement-infrastructure brand — the 0.4 seconds between pay and paid. A portfolio showpiece by Vitalina Nikulina.

MERIDIAN is a scroll-driven narrative site that slows a single payment four thousand times: seven chapters (instant, stream, routing, gate, prism, settlement, paid) trace value moving through a settlement layer as a river of light. Built with React, three.js (TSL/WebGPU-first) and a reduced-motion zero-3D fallback. Not a real company — a design/engineering showcase.

## Site

- [The story](https://meridian.example/#main): the 0.4-second journey, chapter by chapter
- [Talk to us](https://meridian.example/#contact): contact form
